notes.title: End of 1st Pugvent.
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

Hope this weekend was great Pug'llectors.

We're sad to announce the end of the first event, but the opening for some future events.

Stay tuned to Steam and mainly to discord, where we're going to announce a giveaway, and check your own creation pugs.

New:
[list]
[*] Removed PuG the Dev, for now..
[/list]

Once again thank you and have a great week.

notes.title: Event Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

We hope this weekend was great for you Pug'llectors

Today we introduce the Pug the Dev and the removal of the Pug the Artist(doesn't mean he won't come back).

Remember to join discord, we'll be hosting a giveaway, of a removed skin!

We're grateful for your support.

Have a great week ahead.

notes.title: Small Patch 18/08
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

This small Patch is only to correct:
[list]
[*] Localization table for the PT language
[*] Corrected the 3 new skins name in-game. -- Thanks CamperHunter! :D (waiting for your pug :p)
[/list]

Thanks,

Have an awesome week Pug'llectors.

notes.title: Mega Pugdate!!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

Pug'llectors, it is time to announce the [b]first big update[/b]!!

What's new:
[list]
[*] New UI, more updated for smaller resolutions, and easier to select your pugs to change skins! [b]Yey[/b]
[*] New Pugs: 
[olist]
[*]  Pugdates - Our beloved friend
[*]  Tour Pug - Thank you Asanaparada!!
[*]  Pug Artist - Limited Time Skin for this update event!! 
[/olist]
[*] Removed Pugs :
[olist]
[*] Dummy Pug - Our first tester! (no pugs harmed).
[*] Albino Pug - Blue eyes had to go.
[*] Spider Pug - He went back to NYC.
[/olist] 
[*] New Achievements - Related with the new skins, more in the future...
[*] Some game balancing. - this has a possibility to bug your upgrade values! - if you want to reset your save please contact us via discord.
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Remember Pug'llectors, join discord where you can give suggestions, create Pugs and Backgrounds, and share your playground.

We thank you all for your support, and enjoying the game! Without you, we wouldn't be here!

Let's have them all!!!

notes.title: Pugnews
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

We hope this week is going great Pug'llectors.

We're working on the UI update still and some events incoming..

We would like to thank you for joining and believing in the project.

Please don't forget to join discord so that you can leave some suggestions,
And perhaps download the background/Pug files and create your own.

https://discord.gg/nhTNSU23

Have a great day Pug'llectors.

notes.title: Crash Addressing 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

Looks like it was this time.

after some testing and more than 10 hours of idle time, there was no crash.

We'll continue to monitor and test the game, but we think its time to say-

[b]Fixed [/b]

One more time we thank you for your patience and understanding!

Don't forget you can create your own pugs and backgrounds
Join discord for that :D

Have a great weekend Pug'llectors

notes.title: Crash Addressing
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

We would like to thank you one more time for your time, and effort. 

We all want to be Pug'llectors, but we have some challenges ahead.

We've released some fixes to mitigate the crashes, and understand what is causing it.

The fixes, were mainly updating some engine and build versions.
As some code improvements.

We hope the crashes end this time!

If you still had a crash, or got something happening, give a moment to join Discord, and talk with us a little bit!

We thank you all for believing!
And wish you all a great Day/Noon/Night.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

Pug'llectors, here we're again!

Coming with some news, we did hear your pugrayers...

We also have been hearing you about the game crashes! We believe this is fixed, but if it happens, join discord, and we can talk about it!

New:
[list]
[*] Finally escape that fullscreen mode, and use the scale you want!(alt-enter if you want fullscreen)
[*] Close Pug image in-game updated!
[/list]

We're working on a new UI, in order to be more enjoyable with any resolution that you want to use!

Don't forget to close steam, and reopen to update the game! 

Don't hesitate to contact us in our discord, or through reviews! Everyone is welcomed :D

notes.title: Patch 0.1 Pug One
notes.notes:
[b]Hello[/b]

Some rough start! eheh, but we're here Pug'llectors!.

We made some fixes and all saves have been reseted!
Right now you still have your skins / achievements and memory's!

This Update has:
[list]
[*]Fixed a Bug where you could continuously press the background buy button, and loose treats!
[*]Added a save for the sound settings! :)
[*]Fixed the problem with numbers appearing on Treat Counter, that stopped counting.
[/list]

In the work, we have some improvements:
Such as change the resolution and possibility to change to window mode, and leave this infernal fullscreen!
Some events coming, and much more...

We thank everyone who took 1-2 hours of their time to try Pug'llector, and left a review/screenshot.
We want your feedback, and your reviews really are important!

Don't forget to join the Discord, where you can share some ideas and the Pugs you got!

Have a Pug Night!

notes.title: It's Finally out!
notes.notes:
Hello.

We're glad to announce the release of Pug'llector, we hope that you come here to become a Pug'llector yourself.

If you want to add, give an ideia, tell us, we're open for everything.

Enjoy, join the discord, and have FUN!
